comments.content: Renaming this field also changes its Serde wire key. Existing Click to Pay clients using the previously documented `encypted_payload` key will have that value ignored, leaving the authentication payload as `None`. Please preserve request compatibility, for example with `#[serde(alias = "encypted_payload")]`, while exposing the corrected name in the schema.
